namespaces.name: AcmeWidget
namespaces.summary: Primary entry point for creating and processing widgets.
description: AcmeWidget wraps a single configured connection to the widget
registry. Instances are cheap to create but expensive to
reconfigure, so most applications should construct one instance

members.name: process
description: Runs the full validation and transformation pipeline on
`item` and blocks until a result is available.
members.returns: Result -- the processed output, or raises on validation failure.

members.name: process_batch
description: Prefer this over calling `process` in a loop for more than a
few hundred widgets; it batches network round-trips to the
registry and processes up to `parallelism` items at once.
members.returns: list[Result] -- results in the same order as `items`.

members.name: region
members.summary: The AWS-style region this client is bound to.
description: Read-only after construction; create a new `AcmeWidget` to
